categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the Private Broadcast label prior and completely redesigns peer selection, Tor DNS resolution, BIP324 transport, and transaction package relay.
categories.rationale: Redesigns private broadcast to eliminate timing oracles and attacker-manipulated addrman fingerprint vectors while adding 1P1C package relay. As noted in the problem statement, relying on node state and addrman creates exploitable privacy leaks and timing oracles, and the lack of package support blocks private broadcast of low-fee CPFP transactions.
